value.reply: Here's what I found near Springfield for Mia and Leo. Swim lessons at the community pool are for ages 3 to 5, so that one fits Mia, and there are two free library and playgroup options that work for both of them. What should I call you?
groupLeads: Swim lessons at the community pool are for ages 3 to 5, so that one fits Mia. It runs Saturdays at 10:00.
Library storytime is free and open to all ages on Tuesdays at 10:30, so both kids can go. The drop-in playgroup is also free for ages 0 to 6, on weekday mornings, which suits Leo well.
